text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...! How's it going, 
everyone?! Are you having fun?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even a quiet voice is fine! Let's all 
shout together! Ready, and—!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Tachyon. Lives really just aren't 
for me—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hold your tongue before saying that. It's 
still far too early to jump to 
conclusions.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(...Some people are staying, but others 
are leaving the venue.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(Continuing the live performance any 
further might not help bring the Grand 
Live here. In that case, we should wrap it 
up early and explain—)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, let me hear you louder! Let's 
make some noise together! Ready, set—!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: (But... Falcon-san is still...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I-I'm having fun!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: So please, sing even more!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Roger that! Let's get even more 
hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Why don't we stay and watch that live 
performance a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...Sure. Sounds kinda interesting anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're humming along. Looks like 
you're pretty into it too.

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
S-So what, it's fine, isn't it?! I just 
kinda felt like singing, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, keep it up! Let's all sing 
together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, this is a concert where we ask 
everyone to sing along with us, after all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Now then, this is where things 
truly begin.

And so, everyone turned their eyes back to 
the live stage, as if looking upon 
something in a whole new light.
